protocol.name: Ni-NTA Purification of His-Tagged Protein
protocol.purpose: Purify a His-tagged recombinant protein using nickel affinity resin.

steps.text: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 mL of lysis buffer
Lyse the cells using sonication and clarify the lysate by centrifugation at 10,000 rpm for 30 mins.
Equilibrate 5 mL of Ni-NTA resin with 20 mL of lysis buffer.
Load the clarified lysate onto the resin.
Wash the resin with 40 mL of wash buffer containing 20 mM imidazole.
Elute the bound protein using 6 mL of elution buffer containing 300 mM imidazole.
Collect fractions and analyze them by SDS-PAGE.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Problem: Target protein does not bind resin; Possible cause: His-tag is inaccessible or imidazole concentration in binding buffer is too high; Solution: Reduce imidazole in the binding step and confirm the His-tag is intact
Problem: High contaminant bands in elution; Possible cause: Wash conditions were too weak; Solution: Increase wash stringency by adjusting imidazole concentration or wash volume
